gloss_en: the emptying of one's brain/mind of the intellect and da'at it previously held — by imparting one's understanding to another through speech/teaching — thereby vacating space for the surrounding lights (makifim) to enter as new, higher comprehension (Likutey Moharan II:7)
canonical_he: נתרוקן מחו מהשכל והדעת שהיה לו
